$comment: The grammars the app checks every argument against, before it builds a command. Rust (src-tauri/src/grammar.rs) and TypeScript (src/grammar.ts) both read this file; src/test/grammar.test.ts checks it agrees with core. A value is also refused if it is empty, starts with '-', has a control or format character, or runs past `limit` characters.
name: ^([a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9])?)/([a-z][a-z0-9]{0,15})(?:-([a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,14}[a-z0-9])?))?$
